section_summary.extract_value: This section details the informant report methodology, where confidants rated participants' gratitude, forgiveness, personality, and well-being using re-worded versions of the GQ-6, HFS, BFI, and SWLS measures. The measures were adapted to be in the third-person and reflect sex-specific information to aid confidant ratings. No specific study numbers or multiple sample subsets are mentioned.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text: 'Confidants were asked to rate their perception of the participant's gratitude, forgiveness, personality, and well-being. To do so, confidants completed the following measures: (1) GQ-6; (2) HFS; (3) BFI; and (4) SWLS. Measures were re-worded in the third-person and altered to reflect sex specific information (e.g., he vs. she) to assist confidants with ratings.'
